verdict.rationale: First-party docs and the App Store listing describe Advanced Voice Mode for a "real-time convo". ChatGPT Voice lets users talk through ideas and coordinate tasks on desktop without typing, and voice conversations can also be started from the Pets controls. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the real-time, natural conversational quality (latency, interruption handling).

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant

citations.quote: Advanced Voice Mode–Tap the soundwave icon to have a real-time convo on the go.
ChatGPT Voice lets you talk through ideas and coordinate tasks in Chat, Work, and Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app. Start work, check progress, or change direction without switching back to typing.
Type a request or start a voice conversation from the floating Pets controls in the ChatGPT desktop app on macOS and Windows.
